tool_schemas.name: search_servers
tool_schemas.description: Hybrid-search the Toolbox MCP registry for servers matching the provided query and return up to n top-ranked results (default 3, maximum 5) with each server’s basic metadata and available tools; results are returned as a single page and are not cursor-paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or if n is not a number in the allowed range, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to search the registry. Raises RATE_LIMITED when search quota is exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected failures while executing the search.

query.description: Search query for finding MCP servers. You can either write keywords if you want something broad or are referencing a specific server by name, or you can write a detailed description (1-2 sentences) specifying exactly what you are looking for. We perform hybrid search.

tool_schemas.name: use_tool
tool_schemas.description: Execute the named tool on the specified MCP server (qualifiedName) with the provided arguments, and return the tool’s response while recording execution logs including timing and any error details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if qualifiedName is missing/empty, if parameters.name is missing/empty, or if parameters contains disallowed fields; raises NOT_FOUND if the server qualifiedName does not exist in the registry or if the named tool is not exposed by that server. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to execute tools, RATE_LIMITED when execution quota is exceeded, CONFLICT if the server is temporarily unable to accept executions, and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected execution or logging failures.

qualifiedName.description: The qualified name of the server to use

name.description: The name of the tool to call

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the tool

tool_schemas.name: list_mcp_servers
tool_schemas.description: List MCP servers in the Toolbox registry with optional filtering and cursor pagination. Returns only servers visible to the caller; by default excludes non-active servers unless explicitly requested. Refuses invalid filters and returns UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated.

tag.description: Filter to servers containing this tag (exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous list response to continue pagination.

sort.description: Sort order for the result set.

tool_schemas.name: create_mcp_server
tool_schemas.description: Create a new MCP server registry entry in draft status. Returns the created server record. Refuses writes that violate uniqueness constraints (e.g., qualified_name already in use) and returns UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated.

qualified_name.description: Globally unique qualified name used for routing (e.g., "acme.weather").

description.description: Short description of the server and what it provides.

homepage_url.description: Public homepage URL for the server.

transport.description: MCP transport type used to reach the server.

endpoint_url.description: Network endpoint URL for the MCP server (when applicable to the chosen transport).

tags.description: Tags to aid discovery and filtering.

icon_url.description: Icon URL to display in clients.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status. If omitted, defaults to draft.

tool_schemas.name: update_mcp_server
tool_schemas.description: Update an existing MCP server by id, including driving allowed lifecycle state transitions. Returns the updated server record. Refuses invalid transitions, and refuses changing qualified_name once the server has ever been activated (to keep routing stable). Returns NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist.

id.description: Primary key of the MCP server to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must follow allowed transitions: draft→(active|disabled), active→(deprecated|disabled), deprecated→(active|disabled), disabled→active.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_executions
tool_schemas.description: List recorded tool executions with filtering and cursor pagination. Returns execution metadata including status, latency, and any error details; response payloads may be included or omitted depending on include_response. Refuses invalid filters and returns UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated.

qualified_name.description: Filter by MCP server qualified name.

created_after.description: Only return executions created after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return executions created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

include_response.description: Whether to include the response field in each execution record.

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous list response to continue pagination.

sort.description: Sort order for the result set.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_tool_execution
tool_schemas.description: Request cancellation of a tool execution by id. If the execution is queued or running, transitions it to cancelled and returns the updated record; if it is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled), returns the current record without changing state. Returns NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist.

id.description: Primary key of the tool execution to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for cancellation (stored with the execution if supported).
